dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent 'O' shaped structures on the upper dorsal region display irregular, serrated light-colored perimeters with a sharp exterior gradient transition and a more diffuse transition toward the dark central interiors.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of small, solid high-intensity light pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, concentrated primarily near the posterior transition toward the hind flippers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most distinct dorsal macro-annuli form an elongated scalene triangle, while a secondary grouping of four smaller structures on the right lateral flank forms an irregular quadrilateral.
